h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Gangtok

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Gangtok

items.pText: Gangtok is built along steep ridges, and flat ground is the rarest thing on most sites here. Schools, hotels and residential buildings often have a terrace, a cut-out level or a small courtyard for a play area. FunPlay Systems manufactures playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,830 km away, and sends it by road to Sikkim.

The last stretch of that road climbs through the hills, so we plan orders around how the parts will reach your site. Individual equipment and compact play stations are easier to carry up and assemble than one large tower. Gangtok is cool for much of the year, very wet in the monsoon and cold in winter. Our galvanised and roto-moulded materials are made for outdoor use in all of these. Send us photos of your terrace or courtyard and its measurements.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Fitting a play area onto a hillside plot

c: Work with the flat level you have rather than forcing equipment onto a slope. A terrace too small for a play station may still take a swing, a spring rider and a short slide. Check the edges, since a play area next to a drop needs a railing well outside the safe play area. Heavy rain runs fast down hill sites, so the base must drain away from walls and steps. On a concrete terrace, self-standing installation avoids drilling into the slab.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 1,830 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can you install playground equipment on a hillside terrace in Gangtok?
items.a: Yes, if the terrace is level and large enough for the safe play area. We usually suggest self-standing installation on concrete terraces and plan the drainage carefully.

items.q: Will the equipment cope with Gangtok's rain and cold?
items.a: Our galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts are built for outdoor use in wet and cold weather. Springs and bearings should be checked after each monsoon.

items.q: Can large play structures be taken up to Gangtok?
items.a: We plan the order around access to your site. For narrow roads and steep approaches, individual pieces and compact play stations are usually the practical choice.
